framework_source: ITU AI Ready - Analysis Towards a Standardized Readiness Framework, Report 2.0, January 2026

factors.name: Data
factors.description: Accessibility and quality of datasets for analysis of AI applications

factors.name: Research
factors.description: Collaboration between domain-specific and AI research communities

factors.name: Deployment Support
factors.description: Infrastructure and ecosystem readiness for AI deployment

factors.name: Open Source and Code
factors.description: Enabling rapid adoption through an open developer ecosystem

factors.name: Sandbox Environments
factors.description: Platforms for AI experimentation and validation

dimensions.name: Data/Model Marketplace
dimensions.description: Measures the creation of an ecosystem for startups, B2B, or other value-providers to create services from (un)structured data, expert knowledge base, and general platform, and monetize them.

metrics.name: Dataset Properties
metrics.description: Properties of datasets (metadata: types structured/unstructured, number of datasets, volume, velocity, variety, quality)

metrics.name: Model Properties
metrics.description: Properties of models (metadata: types, size, performance, ML/DL, i/o, training dataset parameters)

metrics.name: Data Collection Sources
metrics.description: Location, heterogeneity, number of sources, privacy/trust, synthetic/real world, type of source

metrics.name: Diligence Metrics
metrics.description: License and participation agreement templates for marketplace trust

metrics.name: Marketplace Activity
metrics.description: Number of data producers, consumers, agreements, transactions in the data marketplace

metrics.name: Open Datasets
metrics.description: Number of open datasets, downloads, global citations

metrics.name: Marketplace Participants
metrics.description: Number of active participants and transaction frequencies

metrics.name: Fairness and Bias
metrics.description: Safeguards to manage data bias or data quality risks

metrics.name: Privacy and Security
metrics.description: Privacy-preserving mechanisms, authentication, authorization, just-in-time deletion

metrics.name: Personal Data Standards
metrics.description: Standards on personal data protection

metrics.name: Data Governance
metrics.description: Percentage of datasets under partner agreements, license metrics

metrics.name: Standards-Compliant Formats
metrics.description: Amount of data available in pre-specified standard and interoperable manner

metrics.name: Open-Source Models
metrics.description: Properties of open-source models, openly published weights, number of open-source models by domain

dimensions.name: Generated Content Marketplace
dimensions.description: Measures the ease of creation of new services using AI, including new datasets/models generated for new AI services.

metrics.name: Ecosystem Parameters
metrics.description: Datasets, models for content generation, pluggability, trading/monetization

metrics.name: Guardrails
metrics.description: Availability of guardrails for hallucinations and ethical content

metrics.name: Multi-modal Support
metrics.description: Support for multi-modal content generation

metrics.name: Fake Detection
metrics.description: Evaluation techniques for fake detection

metrics.name: Regional Customization
metrics.description: Customization mechanisms for regional content

dimensions.name: Cross-Domain Correlation Analysis
dimensions.description: Measures cross-domain correlation in integrating AI, finding similarities and patterns in different domain workflows and opportunities for AI integration.

metrics.name: Integrated Workflow
metrics.description: Existence of integrated workflow including prevention, detection, response, and impact analysis

metrics.name: Domain Status
metrics.description: Status of application domains using available data and regional readiness parameters

metrics.name: Domain Models
metrics.description: Domain-specific workflows/models

metrics.name: Domain KPIs
metrics.description: Domain-specific KPIs

metrics.name: Infrastructure Representation
metrics.description: Availability of representation schemes for infrastructure deployment

metrics.name: Cycle Time Reduction
metrics.description: Benefits due to correlation: cycle time reduction via integrated workflows

metrics.name: Coverage and Scale
metrics.description: Coverage in terms of area and scale in terms of deployments

dimensions.name: Contextualization and Regional Impact
dimensions.description: Handles indigenous solutions, contextualization with regional inputs for maximizing community impact, and adoption level of regional solutions at larger scale.

metrics.name: Regional Innovation
metrics.description: Number/quality of regionally developed patents, technology components, solutions

metrics.name: Local Datasets
metrics.description: Availability of structured and accessible local datasets for training AI models

metrics.name: Indigenous Service Users
metrics.description: Number of users of indigenous services

metrics.name: Regional Customizations
metrics.description: Generalized vs. contextualized solutions with local inputs

metrics.name: Technology Adoption
metrics.description: Adoption and scaling of local technologies in other markets

metrics.name: Knowledge Products
metrics.description: Number of localized standard operating procedures, after-action reviews, hybrid AI playbooks

metrics.name: Cultural Diversity
metrics.description: Cultural diversity brought by regional inputs

metrics.name: Best Practices Adoption
metrics.description: Number of new regions adopting AI-based workflow from other regions

metrics.name: Sub-group Representation
metrics.description: Representation of sub-groups in dataset for fine-tuning, prompt-tuning or evaluations

dimensions.name: Level of Integration of AI in Workflows
dimensions.description: Measures how well AI is integrated into domain workflows and how many benefits it provides. AI is seen as a tool to optimize different domain workflows.

metrics.name: Automation Level
metrics.description: Level of automation achieved by integrating AI

metrics.name: Benefits
metrics.description: Benefits achieved by integrating AI

metrics.name: Time/Energy Saved
metrics.description: Time and energy saved through AI integration

metrics.name: Efficiency
metrics.description: Efficiency metrics including containment time

metrics.name: Redundancy
metrics.description: Redundancy in AI-integrated systems

metrics.name: Scalability
metrics.description: Scalability of AI techniques

metrics.name: Integration Level
metrics.description: Level of AI integration at design, coding, and evaluation levels

metrics.name: Model Suitability
metrics.description: Discovery and suitability of model and dataset for the workflow

metrics.name: Service Multiplier
metrics.description: Number of AI services for the same set of resources

metrics.name: Quality Improvement
metrics.description: Improvement in quality of services by integrating AI

metrics.name: Scope Extension
metrics.description: Extension of scope and range of services

metrics.name: Cost Reduction
metrics.description: Demonstrable reduction in cost for similar services

dimensions.name: Human Interface
dimensions.description: Measures the use of AI for ease of human interaction with systems/workflows across various devices.

metrics.name: AI-Ready Interface Penetration
metrics.description: Availability/penetration of applications with AI-ready human interface

metrics.name: Local Language Models
metrics.description: Availability of AI models in the local language used in the human interface

metrics.name: Interaction Channels
metrics.description: Channels and devices (mobiles, kiosks, smart panels, sensors, wearables) for human-AI interaction

metrics.name: Usability Level
metrics.description: Usability level of AI-integrated applications and services

metrics.name: Cultural Sensitivity
metrics.description: Level of cultural sensitivity applied to human interfaces

metrics.name: Safety Integration
metrics.description: Level of safety integrated into the human interface with responsible interaction safeguards

dimensions.name: Strategy Alignment
dimensions.description: Describes the overall gains of coordination for AI integration strategies across distributed entities including stakeholders and domains.

metrics.name: Coordination Level
metrics.description: Level of coordination between service providers: communication channels, vertical coordination, coverage

metrics.name: Time to Go-Live
metrics.description: Time delay in solution delivery from design to deployment

metrics.name: Intent Representations
metrics.description: Top-level intent/vision representations and breakdown into task-specific representations

metrics.name: Interoperability Standards
metrics.description: Standards on interoperability of AI systems in public administrations and private sector

metrics.name: Service Provider Mapping
metrics.description: Availability of service providers and capabilities mapped to top-level intent

metrics.name: Domain Impact
metrics.description: Domains impacted by the top-level intent/vision

metrics.name: Co-benefits Analysis
metrics.description: Correlation and co-benefits between higher-level intents and sub-tasks

metrics.name: International Cooperation
metrics.description: Metrics related to international liaisons and agreements on AI solutions

dimensions.name: Collaboration with AI
dimensions.description: Measures the level of collaboration between humans and AI in various workflows, including dynamic interaction and shaping of AI output.

metrics.name: Co-creation Ease
metrics.description: Ease of collaboration and co-creation (human in inference process)

metrics.name: Traditional Knowledge Integration
metrics.description: Ability to integrate traditional knowledge into AI-based solutions

metrics.name: Exchange Value
metrics.description: Value added by the exchange between humans and AI

metrics.name: Prompting Efficiency
metrics.description: Prompting effort vs. quality of AI-generated component

metrics.name: Baseline Comparison
metrics.description: Comparison of AI co-created output with baseline (AI-only or human-only)

metrics.name: IAPs Supported
metrics.description: Incident Action Plans produced with AI techniques inputs

metrics.name: Fine-tuning Effort
metrics.description: Fine-tuning and optimization efforts vs. results for open-source vs closed models

dimensions.name: Impacts of Humans in AI Integration
dimensions.description: Measures the impact of humans (AI experts, domain experts, general users) on AI integration through modeling, training, fine-tuning, and adoption.

metrics.name: Skill Distribution
metrics.description: Skill distribution and levels in AI, Cloud, IoT, 5G technologies

metrics.name: Expert Intersection
metrics.description: Intersection of domain experts aware of AI and AI practitioners aware of domain techniques

metrics.name: Ecosystem Readiness
metrics.description: Ecosystem readiness/ability to develop AI skills and talents

metrics.name: AI Awareness
metrics.description: AI awareness and adoption levels among end-users

metrics.name: Training Programs
metrics.description: Number of academic programmes or certified training courses in AI

metrics.name: Experts Trained
metrics.description: Number of experts trained per year on AI-supported workflows

metrics.name: Skills Gap
metrics.description: Skills gap analysis identifying currently lacking skills

metrics.name: Action Latency
metrics.description: Inference-to-action latency: time from detection to human action

dimensions.name: AI & Policies
dimensions.description: Two-fold: measures ability to use AI for policy experimentation and extrapolation, and readiness of policies to enable smooth AI integration.

metrics.name: Policy Sandbox
metrics.description: Availability of sandboxes evaluating domain-specific policies for vertical applications

metrics.name: Policy Evaluation
metrics.description: Domain-specific policies and evaluation mechanisms for AI-integrated solutions

metrics.name: Policy Extrapolation
metrics.description: Extrapolation mechanisms for policy interventions with simulated timeline

metrics.name: Horizontal Policies
metrics.description: Availability of horizontal generic policies (data sources, AI lifecycle, explainability)

metrics.name: Community Benefit
metrics.description: Number of instances where AI enables community benefit with citizen inputs

metrics.name: Safety Policies
metrics.description: Policies for safe, responsible, reliable operation of AI

metrics.name: Explainability Metrics
metrics.description: Metrics to measure explainability and transparency for accountability

metrics.name: Policy Case Briefs
metrics.description: Number of published briefs/case studies turning operational lessons into governance lessons

metrics.name: Audit Metrics
metrics.description: Metrics from audits of models, datasets, toolsets for bias, safety, explainability

metrics.name: Data Sovereignty
metrics.description: Policies related to ownership and movement of data

dimensions.name: AI for Inclusion
dimensions.description: Studies bridging divides in society using AI including accessibility, gender divide, and other forms of inclusion across simulation, edge AI, and GenAI.

metrics.name: Digital Twins
metrics.description: Number of sandbox environments and capability of simulators

metrics.name: Sensor Types
metrics.description: Types of sensors (laser, cameras, gyroscope, obstacle avoidance)

metrics.name: Edge AI Agents
metrics.description: Use of agents for user interface, e.g., question answers for navigation

metrics.name: Edge Hardware
metrics.description: Hardware availability and affordability at the edge (CPU, GPU, memory, network)

metrics.name: 5G Connectivity
metrics.description: 5G connectivity for edge-to-cloud including coverage

metrics.name: Edge Privacy
metrics.description: Standalone edge vs. cloud data transfer privacy

metrics.name: Language Repository
metrics.description: Local grammar, dialects, and context for interaction included in language repository

metrics.name: Regional Language Support
metrics.description: Offline/local-language access including offline alert kits

metrics.name: GenAI Customization
metrics.description: Customizations in presentations (avatar appearances)

metrics.name: Multi-modal Data
metrics.description: Different types of data processed (audio, video, images) using standard representations

metrics.name: Beneficiaries
metrics.description: Number of users/beneficiaries including sign language support

metrics.name: Women/Indigenous Leadership
metrics.description: Women's leadership and indigenous leadership in AI

metrics.name: Social Inclusion Impact
metrics.description: Impact of AI on social inclusion decisions

dimensions.name: Granular Priorities
dimensions.description: Measures the availability of granular priorities in adapting AI-based solutions to subsets of users, considering local needs and context.

metrics.name: Regional Priorities
metrics.description: Regional/domain-specific priorities and focus areas

metrics.name: Fine-tuned Models
metrics.description: Fine-tuned workflows and models reflecting regional priorities

metrics.name: Priority Organization
metrics.description: Existence of organizational structure for evolution of granular priorities

metrics.name: Customized Workflows
metrics.description: Evolution of downstream customized workflows derived from global workflows/models

dimensions.name: Digital Infrastructure
dimensions.description: Measures the availability of digital infrastructure including devices, computing capability, connectivity, and energy for AI deployment.

metrics.name: AI-Enabled Devices
metrics.description: Number/quality/distribution of AI-enabled devices/sensors (ITU-T Y.3172 nodes)

metrics.name: Data Centers
metrics.description: Number of data centers and APIs integrated in the overall solution

metrics.name: Digital Services
metrics.description: Number of digital services integrated in cloud cross-domain solution

metrics.name: Edge Infrastructure
metrics.description: Availability and utilization of edge clouds, compute at edge, connectivity to edge

metrics.name: Energy Consumption
metrics.description: Energy consumption at edge, devices, and infrastructure for AI and domain-specific

metrics.name: Energy Sustainability
metrics.description: Energy reliability and sustainable energy usage (power usage effectiveness)

metrics.name: Uptime
metrics.description: Percentage uptime of towers/cameras and control room feeds

metrics.name: Area Coverage
metrics.description: Area covered under AI services including sensors for data collection and actuators

metrics.name: Network Quality
metrics.description: Quality of network connectivity (fiber, wireless, 5G coverage) per ITU-R M.2410
